headline: SIREXE 2026: the extractive and energy industries gathering mobilises FCFA 4,913 billion in investment prospects
summary: The second SIREXE extractive and energy fair, held 18 to 22 November in Abidjan, reported 4,913 billion FCFA of investment prospects. It also recorded 27 signed agreements and a cooperation accord between Côte d'Ivoire and Botswana.
why: Extractive and energy investment fairs bring together mining and energy companies with governments, and the deals signed shape future project pipelines in producing countries.
original_headline: SIREXE 2026 : le rendez-vous des industries extractives et énergétiques mobilise 4 913 milliards FCFA de perspectives d’investissement
